stories.text: 🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: Ramosverse just moved above the projected league median.
🪦 The eulogy is in: Purdy Good gets its send-off (19.40 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: 49er Faith-Fool vs Ramosverse. Playoff odds with a win / loss: 49er Faith-Fool 75% / 50%, Ramosverse 20% / 6.2%.
🔮 Brock You Like a Hurricane vs Claremont In Yo Stace! is tightening — the projected margin shrank to 37.33 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: 49er Faith-Fool: 76% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 44% with none (now 67%).
🏟️ Game to watch: CAR @ GB (Thursday 8:15 PM), 8 league starters in action with 109.74 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (CAR @ GB): 8 league starters in action. Most riding on it: The Mahomies vs Ruffing the Passer (63.57 pts projected).
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: Gibb it to Me Baby has 4 starters on bye this week (Collins, Olave, Likely and Purdy). Hope the bench is ready.
🏈 5 matchups are still up for grabs, and The Mahomies vs Ruffing the Passer (The Mahomies 51%) is the tightest.
📰 Jets WR Garrett Wilson says he doesn't want to be traded but does want to win. That's 49er Faith-Fool's starting WR. Developing.
📈 TRENDING: Every other league is scrambling for Seth McGowan (RB, IND). Ours has him sitting on waivers.
🕰️ Hindsight swap: If Ramosverse and Brock You Like a Hurricane had swapped Washington and McBride for Bowers and Watson back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 22% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
